nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover.
Hygen.symbol token ticker, set to "H2" in the constructor.
Hygen.name token name, set to "Hygen" in the constructor.
Hygen.decimals token precision, fixed at 18.
Hygen._totalSupply total minted supply, 800000000*10**18 in the constructor.
mapping(address=>uint) balances: token balance per account, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance table mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for balances, allowances and every ownership check.
Overflow-prone addition a + b guarded only by require(c >= a) inside SafeMath.safeAdd, reached from transfer/transferFrom balance credits.
Underflow-prone subtraction a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside SafeMath.safeSub, used for debiting balances and allowances.
Overflow-prone multiplication a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside SafeMath.safeMul.
External call to an arbitrary spender contract: ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
External call to an arbitrary token contract: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token.
Arithmetic in transferFrom: the Transfer event emits tokens*10**18 while balances are moved by tokens, an incorrect scaling arithmetic operation.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked addition helper.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked subtraction helper.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): checked multiplication helper.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): division helper requiring b > 0.
Owned() public constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages the pending new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() public: requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves ownership and clears newOwner.
Hygen() public constructor: sets metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Hygen.totalSupply() public constant returns (uint): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
Hygen.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant returns (uint balance): returns balances[tokenOwner].
Hygen.transfer(address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success): moves tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd.
Hygen.approve(address spender, uint tokens) public returns (bool success): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend protection.
Hygen.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success): debits from, debits allowance and credits to.
Hygen.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant returns (uint remaining): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Hygen.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public returns (bool success): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Hygen fallback function () public payable: unconditionally reverts, refusing all plain ETH transfers.
Hygen.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner returns (bool success): owner-only sweep of arbitrary ERC20 tokens via external call.
Parameter `to` of Hygen.transfer: recipient whose balance is credited.
Parameter `tokens` of Hygen.transfer: amount subtracted from msg.sender and added to the recipient.
Parameter `spender` of Hygen.approve: address granted the allowance.
Parameter `tokens` of Hygen.approve: allowance amount written to allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter `from` of Hygen.transferFrom: account debited, not validated against msg.sender beyond the allowance.
Parameter `to` of Hygen.transferFrom: recipient whose balance is credited.
Parameter `tokens` of Hygen.transferFrom: amount debited from `from` and credited to `to`.
Parameter `spender` of Hygen.approveAndCall: allowance target and address of the externally called contract.
Parameter `tokens` of Hygen.approveAndCall: allowance amount written before the external call.
Parameter `data` of Hygen.approveAndCall: attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter `tokenAddress` of Hygen.transferAnyERC20Token: arbitrary external contract that is called.
Parameter `tokens` of Hygen.transferAnyERC20Token: amount forwarded to the external token contract.
Parameter `_newOwner` of Owned.transferOwnership: address staged as the pending owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into the owner state variable by the Owned constructor, defining the privileged account.
Owned constructor writes state_owner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes, the only access-control gate on ownership handover.
state_owner is read inside the onlyOwner modifier that guards transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into state_newOwner.
acceptOwnership reverts unless msg.sender == newOwner, making msg.sender the authorization key for ownership takeover.
state_newOwner is read for the require check and used to promote the caller to owner.
acceptOwnership overwrites state_owner with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets state_newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
Hygen constructor assigns the symbol metadata.
Hygen constructor assigns the name metadata.
Hygen constructor assigns the decimals metadata.
Hygen constructor mints and stores the entire _totalSupply.
Hygen constructor credits the full supply into balances of a hard-coded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for the requested account.
allowance returns the nested allowed mapping entry.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address directly selects the account being moved.
transfer updates the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer credits the recipient through SafeMath addition, exercising the overflow-prone safeAdd operation.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
Parameter `to` of transfer is used as the key whose balance is credited.
Parameter `tokens` of transfer determines both the debit and the credit amounts.
Parameter `tokens` is the operand fed into the safeAdd credit computation.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller controls the allowance owner slot.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry, including the known approval race condition pattern.
Parameter `spender` of approve is the key of the written allowance entry.
Parameter `tokens` of approve is written verbatim as the new allowance.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so the spender identity comes from msg.sender.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for the `from` and `to` accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of the spender.
transferFrom performs two safeSub subtractions, on the balance and on the allowance, exercising the underflow-prone subtraction.
transferFrom emits an event amount computed as tokens*10**18, an unscaled arithmetic operation inconsistent with the transferred amount.
Parameter `from` of transferFrom selects the balance and allowance source account.
Parameter `to` of transferFrom is the credited recipient.
Parameter `tokens` of transferFrom drives both balance and allowance debits.
Parameter `tokens` is multiplied by 10**18 before being emitted in the Transfer event.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee.
approveAndCall updates the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an arbitrary spender contract, which can re-enter the token through that callback.
Parameter `spender` of approveAndCall is used both as allowance key and as the address invoked.
Parameter `spender` is the attacker-controlled target address of the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter `tokens` of approveAndCall sets the allowance before the callback.
Parameter `data` of approveAndCall is forwarded unvalidated to the external contract.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
state_owner gates the privileged sweep and is itself used as the external transfer recipient.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller, allowing reentrant execution.
Parameter `tokenAddress` of transferAnyERC20Token chooses the contract that is called.
Parameter `tokenAddress` is the callee address of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter `tokens` of transferAnyERC20Token is passed to the external transfer call.
SafeMath.safeAdd is the implementation of the overflow-prone addition operation.
SafeMath.safeSub is the implementation of the underflow-prone subtraction operation.
SafeMath.safeMul is the implementation of the overflow-prone multiplication operation.

normalization_plan.reason: `to` is a non-core parameter whose only role is to key the balances write inside Hygen.transfer, so it collapses into that core function.
`tokens` is a non-core parameter consumed solely by Hygen.transfer when computing the sender debit and recipient credit.
`spender` exists only as the allowance key written by Hygen.approve and can be folded into that core function.
`tokens` is a non-core parameter written directly into the allowed mapping by Hygen.approve.
`from` is a non-core parameter used only to index balances and allowed inside Hygen.transferFrom.
`to` is a non-core parameter used only as the credited balance key inside Hygen.transferFrom.
`tokens` is a non-core parameter driving the debits and the event arithmetic inside Hygen.transferFrom.
`spender` becomes the callee address of the external receiveApproval call, so it merges into that unsafe operation node.
`tokens` is a non-core parameter only used to set the allowance inside Hygen.approveAndCall.
`data` is forwarded untouched as the calldata of the external receiveApproval call and therefore belongs to that unsafe operation.
`tokenAddress` is the arbitrary external contract that is called, so it merges into the external-call unsafe operation.
`tokens` is a non-core parameter only forwarded as the amount argument of the owner-gated sweep function.
`_newOwner` is a non-core parameter whose sole effect is to populate the newOwner state variable inside Owned.transferOwnership.
